closed_issues.title: Incorrect stereochemistry of D-alloisoleucine in ambocidin SMILES
Spaghettis where linearisation is stopped mid-way cannot be drawn
Unable to release chain when the only PKS substrate is O-methylacetyl-CoA
Wildcards not recognised when setting stereochemistry after dehydration
NRPS cyclodehydration doesn't check for presence of leaving hydrogen
Beta-amino acid cannot be incorporated when KR domain acts on aspartic acids
Side chains are not restricted from being drawn higher than or overlapping with bubbles
Backbones overlapping with atoms part of 3-membered rings are incorrectly drawn
Backbones overlapping aromatic ring systems are sometimes incorrectly drawn
